markdown:
May 29, 1934

Section of Field Records Report on H-5397 Chief of party R.W. Knox

Surveyed in Apr.- June 1933

Protracted by A.J. Wollmar

Surveyed by R.W. Knox

Verified and inked by A.M. Uzeforich

Soundings plotted by A.J. Wollmar

1. The records conform to the requirements of the General Instructions, except Vol. I page 38, positions 112b-113b, where the spacing of time was not indicated, property 2. The field plotting was completed to the extent prescribed in the General Instructions. 3. The hydrography is incomplete, and the usual depth curves of one, two, three, five, and even ten fathoms can not be drawn for their full extention. 4. The office cartographer inked MLLW line, and improved slightly, according to Topo, sheets 4825 and 4826, the shore line, done by the field party. 5. The junction with adjacent sheet H-5396 was not made, as this sheet is not inked yet. The junction with adjacent sheet H-4559 was also not made. This sheet has scale l:120,000 6. Remarks: Vol.2, p. 47, position 106e (205 m. S.W. of O Bum, Lat. 33°46') mentioned: "Bending Ift, to avoid rock", there is no rock on Smooth sheet, Boat sheet, and

- left

Topo. 4826. There is on Smooth sheet a symbol + for sunken rock (125 m. N. of O Sum, Lat. 33°48.2), which does not show on Boat Sheet and Topo. 4826. There are also ou Smooth sheet thres small islands (60 m. S.E. of OLY-Lat. 33°44!2, 80 m. N.W. of @ No-Lat. 33°48.4, and 120m. S.W.of OBlue-Lat. 33°49"1) which do not appear on Boat sheet, or on Topo. 4825 and 4826. The buoy at Lat. 33°46! 6 and Long 118°25'9 does not show on Topo. 4826. Vol. 3, p. 14- mentioned: " strong currents along submarine valley" (near Lat. 33°50). 7. The quality of the work is fair.

Respectfully submitted alexis M. Uzefovich
